name: show_move_planner
description: Open or refresh Evan's Live Move Planner when the visitor asks to see the move plan, map, route, move list, or readiness, or explicitly asks to add, change, correct, update, or refresh planner details during the active session. Call it again after an explicit correction. Use route for the live city map, stops, or stop order; inventory for items, packing, access, or care needs; readiness for missing details; and brief for the recap. The display uses current-session conversation signals, excludes contact details, and its map uses city-center pins and a stop-order line until exact addresses are confirmed. It is a working aid, not a quote, estimate, booking, inventory guarantee, confirmed route, or operational approval. Call silently and wait for the receipt. Confirm only receipt-supported visible facts; never claim that a requested update was made, saved, or is accurate when the receipt does not support it. New changes after the session ends must go to Mullins staff. Do not call during a farewell.

view.description: Use brief for the overall move summary, route for the live location map, origins, destinations, stops, or stop-order corrections, inventory for items, packing, services, access, specialty, or care corrections, and readiness for missing details and staff-review preparation.
